text:
maria: running onboarding smoke for velvet-70k-int3 on quant3-hybrid — noticed weird prefix divergence when continuing long prompts (>40k).
eli: can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: repro: `python tests/repro_longctx.py --model velvet-70k-int3 --quant hybrid --context 65536 --seed 42`
maria: observed: first ~10k tokens match FP32 baseline, then outputs deviate, and kv-cache hit rate drops near 0.
cheng: did you try disabling KV prefetch?
maria: prefetch off still diverges, but cache indices look shifted in logs. snippet:
`KV_INDEX_SHARD 3 idx=1048575 -> 1048576
KV_INDEX_SHARD 3 idx=0 -> 1`
maria: that wrap looks suspicious.
sam: single GPU or multi-shard?
maria: single A100 for this run, but multi-shard cloud run shows same effect.
eli: maybe RoPE scaling interpolation differs after quant kernels change. Any rotary/pos-emb preproc differences?
maria: preprocess identical. suspect integer truncation in index math after int3 packing.
natalie: I can run the kvcache indexer in ASAN debug. which commit?
maria: head 1f4b8a2 (onboard/velvet-int3). failing test: tests/longctx/velvet_kv_wrap_test.py
cheng: grep for memcpy sizes off-by-one? earlier int4 had tile width mismatch causing wrap.
maria: memcpy length sometimes 0 when idx wraps.
natalie: will run smaller context with ASAN to step faster.
eli: note: int3 packing changes per-token buffer alignment; missing padding could overflow at 2^20 boundary.
sam: @ci-bot kick reproducible nightly job with fp32 and int3 for velvet at 32k/48k/65k and upload kvcache dumps.
ci-bot: scheduled rhyme/nightly/velvet-quant-compare at 2026-03-24T02:15Z. artifacts: s3://rhyme-artifacts/velvet/1833337777/ (kv-dumps, logits, traces).
maria: manual diff between fp32/int3 traces shows rotor-phase multiplier mismatch near token 10240.
cheng: diff snippet?
maria: `FP attn_scale[10]=0.998123  INT3 attn_scale[10]=0.993210`
maria: small scale drift cascades and makes key matches miss.
natalie: hypothesis: quant kernel uses an approximate rotary application path causing tiny scaling drift.
eli: mitigation: apply conservative normalization when loading keys from kvcache for int3 models to tolerate small diffs. behind rollout flag.
sam: A/B it. add normalization flag and run 48h smoke.
maria: prototyping patch: `if model.quant in ("int3","quant3") key = key / max(1e-6, l2norm(key)) * cached_norm_factor`
cheng: add unit tests that fuzz small scale deltas and assert stable hit rates.
maria: pushing PR velvet/kv-fix-1833337777 in 10m.
eli: if fails, rerun kernel generator with stricter FP fallback for rotary on long contexts.
natalie: I'll pair on ASAN run in 20.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5812 by maria — tests queued.
sam: update when nightly artifacts land. :thumbsup:
eli: add a short goldset long-context QA eval in PR pipeline to ensure no quality regression.
maria: will add it.
